senses.gloss: cleaving, cleft; that which is cloven, a log. Pl. בְּקִיעוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:23:1">Koh. R. to II, 23</cite> <he>בקע לי שתי ב׳</he> chop for me two logs; (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 27:2">Gen. R. s. 27</cite> <he>בקעיות</he>, v. <cite ref="B01133"><he>בְּקַעַת</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:9:1">Koh. R. to X, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 55:8">Gen. R. s. 55</cite>, end <he>בשכר שתי ב׳ שבקע וכ׳</he> as a reward for the two pieces of wood which Abraham chopped (<cite ref="Genesis 22:3">Gen. XXII, 3</cite>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 101a:5">Sabb. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>בְּקִיעַת דגים</he> the crossing of fish under the ship.
